description:
The Ultimate Lightweight Aluminum Cruiser for Coastal Living

Experience the perfect blend of classic style and modern performance. The Firmstrong Urban Lady Alloy is specifically engineered with a 6061 Aluminum Alloy frame, making it significantly lighter and more maneuverable than traditional steel cruisers. Weighing in at approximately 32 lbs, it’s a breeze to pedal, easy to lift, and built to last.

Rust-Resistant & Ocean-Ready If you live near the coast, salt air is the enemy of steel. Our aluminum beach cruiser naturally resists corrosion, ensuring your frame stays pristine even in high-moisture beach environments. It’s the ideal choice for riders in California, Florida, or any coastal town where durability is a top priority.

Why Riders Love the Urban Lady Alloy:

Featherlight Maneuverability: The light alloy frame makes starting, stopping, and pedaling uphill feel nearly effortless.

Pure Simplicity: A single-speed design with a classic KT coaster brake (pedal backward to stop). No messy cables, no complicated gears—just pure riding joy.

Don't let the one-speed simplicity fool you. Whether you are cruising the Huntington Beach pier or exploring city streets, the Urban Lady Aluminum provides a responsive, rust-proof, and comfortable ride that looks as good as it feels.

Featherlight Maneuverability: The light alloy frame makes starting, stopping, and pedaling uphill feel nearly effortless.

Pure Simplicity: A single-speed design with a classic KT coaster brake (pedal backward to stop). No messy cables, no complicated gears—just pure riding joy.

Signature Comfort: Features an oversized dual-spring saddle and 2.125” wide "balloon" tires that soak up every bump on the boardwalk.

Upright Riding Geometry: Designed to keep your back straight and shoulders relaxed, preventing the strain common with mountain or road bikes.

Efficient Cruising: Maintains a smooth 5–15 mph pace with minimal effort, perfect for casual 0–20 mile trips.

15” Steel Frame with 26” Aluminum Wheels

Light Aluminum Frame makes riding more efficient and also ensures no rusting

Single Speed Bike with a Pedal-Backwards Coaster Brake for easy pedaling and smooth braking

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide White-Wall Tires provides a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

28.5” Wide Cruiser Bike Handlebars with Hi-Density Foam Grips

Bicycle Weighs 32 lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Men 5’2" – 5’11" Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 15mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 20 miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Color Matched Fenders can be Purchased Separately for $49.99.

Bike comes 80% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
